previous.observation: Root actual own F1156 guide/raw/fullWB/3x coil: exactly two low-ear/nape beads connect gray bob to shoulder-front coil. Two distinct dark gray inner-return panels are visible at normal scale and crop, material P1; those panels are actual opaque hair, not air to erase. Small gray terminal return/C is present but compressed, do not inherit74 absent-small-turn P1. New iris main fill is now gray plus lighter interior with no separate center black dot; warmth/value differs from accepted master, P2 color-only issue. Source asymmetric eyes/glints/small smile, different finger groups/cuffs and asymmetric bow kept. Raw outside cloud disappears on WB. Independent material P1 agrees. No whole-art acceptance or actual dynamic check.
